71 of the 163 peptides had at least one linkage with LOD > 3, and there was a total of 93 such distinct linkages.
110 of the 163 transcripts had at least one linkage with LOD > 3, and there was a total of 140 such distinct linkages.

Of the 93 distinct loci linking to peptide abundance, 18 also linked to the abundance of the corresponding transcript with LOD > 3, 19 linked to the abundance of the corresponding peptide with 1 < LOD < 3, and 56 did not show linkage to the abundance of the corresponding peptide (LOD < 1).

Of the 140 distinct loci linking to transcript abundance, 17 also linked to the abundance of the corresponding peptide with LOD > 3, 31 linked to the abundance of the corresponding transcript with 1 < LOD < 3, and 92 did not show linkage to the abundance of the corresponding transcript (LOD < 1).
Of the 109 loci detected originally, 79 were also detected in this new analysis, along with 17 additional linkages.
